_note: Lifetime-distance achievements (src/constants.js DIST_ACHIEVEMENTS). Same array shape as ach_translations_9_1.json: [title, post-earned description, pre-earned description]. Play Console has ONE description field - use the pre-earned string there. Icons: achievement-icons/dist_moon.png, dist_sun.png (512x512 RGB, no alpha). Points: moon 25, sun 50. Hidden: No. Incremental: No.

tunl_ach_dist_moon: To the Moon
You have flown as far as the Moon.
Across all your runs, fly the distance to the Moon.
tunl_ach_dist_sun: To the Sun
You have flown as far as the Sun.
Across all your runs, fly the distance to the Sun.

tunl_ach_dist_sun: Bis zur Sonne
Du bist so weit geflogen wie bis zur Sonne.
